result.instructions: Tools for Parseo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Upload this invoice PDF and tell me when it is processed."; "List the invoices that are not exported yet, and show their totals."; "How many credits are left this month, and which uploads are waiting for credits?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Parseo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run parseo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run parseo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run parseo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. parseo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: parseo_get_key_info
tools.title: Get API key info
tools.description: Show the team, plan, scopes and rate limit of the API key in use. Good first call to check that the key works. Parseo: GET /me.

tools.name: parseo_get_credit_balance
tools.title: Get credit balance
tools.description: Show the credit balance, the low-balance threshold and this billing cycle's usage. Jobs with awaiting_credits wait for this balance to rise. Parseo: GET /me/credits.

tools.name: parseo_get_quota
tools.title: Get quota snapshot
tools.description: Show credits, plan limits and current usage in one reply. Parseo: GET /me/quota.

tools.name: parseo_get_usage
tools.title: Get usage metrics
tools.description: Show invoice usage per day for the last N days (1-90). Parseo: GET /usage.

tools.name: parseo_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices of the client in use, with filters for status, direction, export state, dates, amounts and names. The list omits line items: fetch one invoice for its full content. Requires invoice:read. Parseo: GET /invoices.

direction.description: purchase = incoming bill, sale = outgoing invoice.

exported.description: false = invoices nobody has exported yet (an import queue).

changed_since_export.description: true = exported invoices corrected after their export.

is_export_valid.description: true = only invoices that pass export validation.

created_from.description: Created at or after this time.

created_to.description: Created at or before this time.

total_min.description: Total amount at or above this value.

total_max.description: Total amount at or below this value.

invoice_number.description: Exact invoice number, or 'prefix:ABC' for a prefix match.

expand.description: 'seller', 'buyer' or 'seller,buyer': replace contact ids with contact objects.

client_id.description: Client id (cl_...) for a team-wide key. Omit it to use the client set at login.

tools.name: parseo_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice with its extracted data, line items, export block and assignment status. Use it after a job completes (invoiceId). Requires invoice:read. Parseo: GET /invoices/{id}.

invoice_id.description: Invoice id (inv_...), from the job or the list.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level fields to return, for example id,status,totalAmount.

expand.description: 'seller', 'buyer' or 'seller,buyer': replace contact ids with contact objects.

client_id.description: Client id (cl_...) for a team-wide key. Omit it to use the client set at login.

tools.name: parseo_get_invoice_status
tools.title: Get invoice status
tools.description: Get the processing status of one invoice (queued, processing, processed or failed). Requires invoice:read. Parseo: GET /invoices/{id}/status.

client_id.description: Client id (cl_...) for a team-wide key. Omit it to use the client set at login.

tools.name: parseo_export_invoice
tools.title: Export an invoice
tools.description: Export one invoice as JSON (default), XML, or an accounting-system format (for example rivile, odoo, b1). Non-JSON formats return the text in 'body'. Fetching does not mark the invoice as exported. Requires invoice:export. Parseo: GET /invoices/{id}/export.

client_id.description: Client id (cl_...) for a team-wide key. Omit it to use the client set at login.

tools.name: parseo_list_jobs
tools.title: List ingestion jobs
tools.description: List upload jobs with their status (processing, awaiting_credits, completed, failed). Use it to find a job that has no invoice yet. Parseo: GET /jobs.

client_id.description: Only jobs of this client (cl_... id).

tools.name: parseo_get_job
tools.title: Get an ingestion job
tools.description: Get one upload job. Poll it until status is completed (invoiceId is set), failed (error is set) or awaiting_credits (parked until credits arrive, not an error). Parseo: GET /jobs/{jobId}.

job_id.description: Job id (job_...), from the upload reply.

tools.name: parseo_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List the clients (end customers) of the team. Each client has an id (cl_...) for X-Client-Id. Requires client:read. Parseo: GET /clients.

tools.name: parseo_get_client
tools.title: Get a client
tools.description: Get one client with its company details. Requires client:read. Parseo: GET /clients/{id}.

tools.name: parseo_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List buyer and supplier contacts, optionally for one client. Requires contact:read. Parseo: GET /contacts.

client_id.description: Only contacts of this client (cl_... id).

tools.name: parseo_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact (buyer or supplier). Requires contact:read. Parseo: GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: parseo_list_audit_logs
tools.title: List audit log
tools.description: Query the team audit log: who did what, and when (for example invoice.created or api_key.rotated). Requires audit:read. Parseo: GET /audit-logs.

api_key_id.description: Only actions of this API key (ak_... id).

action.description: Exact action name, for example invoice.created.

tools.name: parseo_upload_invoice
tools.title: Upload an invoice
tools.description: Upload one invoice file (PDF, PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 7.5 MB) for OCR. It returns a job at once (HTTP 202); the invoice exists only after the job completes. Uses credits. Pass the same idempotency_key to retry safely. Requires invoice:write. Parseo: POST /invoices.

direction.description: purchase = incoming bill, sale = outgoing invoice. Leave it out to use Parseo's default.

partner_invoice_id.description: Your own id for this invoice, stored in metadata.partnerInvoiceId.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key: send the same key on a retry of the same upload. Parseo keeps the first result for 24 hours.

client_id.description: Client id (cl_...) for a team-wide key. Omit it to use the client set at login.

tools.name: parseo_upload_invoices_batch
tools.title: Upload several invoices
tools.description: Upload up to 10 invoice files in one call (PDF, PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 7.5 MB each). Each result has its own jobId and status. Uses credits. Pass the same idempotency_key to retry safely. Requires invoice:write. Parseo: POST /invoices/batch.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key: send the same key on a retry of the same upload. Parseo keeps the first result for 24 hours.

client_id.description: Client id (cl_...) for a team-wide key. Omit it to use the client set at login.

tools.name: parseo_update_invoice
tools.title: Update an invoice
tools.description: Correct the extracted fields of one invoice. Send only the fields to change; a changed exported invoice shows changedSinceExport. Requires invoice:write. Parseo: PATCH /invoices/{id}.

metadata.description: Your own key-value data, stored with the invoice.

client_id.description: Client id (cl_...) for a team-wide key. Omit it to use the client set at login.

tools.name: parseo_mark_invoice_exported
tools.title: Mark an invoice as exported
tools.description: Record that your system imported this invoice, so it leaves the export queue (exported=false). Repeat calls do not add exports. Use it only after your import succeeded. Requires invoice:export. Parseo: POST /invoices/{id}/exported.

external_reference.description: Your own id for the imported document, for example ERP-2026-00412.

client_id.description: Client id (cl_...) for a team-wide key. Omit it to use the client set at login.

tools.name: parseo_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: Create a client (an end customer of your team). Use its id (cl_...) as client_id on invoice calls. Requires client:write. Parseo: POST /clients.

tools.name: parseo_update_client
tools.title: Update a client
tools.description: Change the details of one client. Send only the fields to change. Requires client:write. Parseo: PATCH /clients/{id}.

tools.name: parseo_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a buyer or supplier contact for one client. Requires contact:write. Parseo: POST /contacts.

client_id.description: The client this contact belongs to (cl_...).

tools.name: parseo_update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: Change the details of one contact. Send only the fields to change. Requires contact:write. Parseo: PATCH /contacts/{id}.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Parseo
prompts.description: What you can do with Parseo here, with example requests to try.
